data.name: Order Picker Simulator
data.detailed_description:
EXPERIENCE THE ROMANCE AND AGONY OF BEING AN ORDER PICKER!

You are a newly minted "partner" of the giant corporation Ultra Fresh Food. Well, calling you a partner is a stretch... You're more like an efficient little cog in the machine, trapped in a franchise loan. At your disposal: a small, slightly gloomy warehouse hangar, a handheld laser scanner, and an endless stream of orders from both hungry customers and corporate management.

Your goal is to turn this chaos into a perfectly oiled mechanism, make a mountain of cash, and... avoid going completely bankrupt at midnight when the corporation sends you the bill for the "privilege of breathing the brand's air."

GAME FEATURES:

  • 📦 True Warehouse Core Loop: Order boxes of groceries via your work laptop, stock them on shelves, and monitor inventory so your racks never go empty. Keeping your warehouse organized is the ultimate key to hyper-fast picking!

  • 📈 Every Day is a Challenge: Ultra Fast Fresh is absolutely thrilled to exploit your labor for corporate profit! Every workday brings a new mandatory task from upper management. Fail, and you'll face brutal fines. Succeed, and your reward is... even more tasks! Think keeping 10 different varieties of potatoes on your shelves is optional? Think again!

  • 🛒 Pure ASMR Gameplay: Indulge in crisp, highly satisfying, dopamine-inducing sounds. The sharp, satisfying "beep" of the laser scanner reading barcodes, the rustle of paper bags, and the thud of heavy boxes will help you forget all your stress (or add some fresh new panic!).

  • 🧊 Extreme Picking & Temperature Zones: Sticking to regular shelves is for casuals. Grab a bag and sprint into the massive industrial freezer to pick frozen goods! But you'd better hurry: your screen will quickly cover in frost, and the freezing temperature will serve as a cold reminder that your human resources are definitely limited.

  • ⏰ Midnight Hour of Reckoning: Time flies when you're rushing! At the end of the shift, the corporation will check your balance and forcefully deduct the franchise tax. Managed to stay in the green? Keep grinding! Ended up in the negative? You have exactly one day to fix your finances, or you're completely bankrupt.

  • 🎨 DIY Renovations (Customization): Tired of drab gray concrete? Spend your hard-earned dollars on visually upgrading the darkstore! Swap out flooring materials and repaint the walls to create a cozy atmosphere in your workspace. The franchise is happy to let you browse the building materials catalog... but, of course, they won't reimburse you a single hard-earned cent.
